entities.name: Mithridates V of Parthia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mithridates V was a Parthian contender from 129 to 140. Sources claim he was either a son of Pacorus II or a brother of Osroes I. His son, Vologases IV of Parthia (147–191), took the throne after the death of Vologases III in 147.
